newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 200 bln lire of Italy 18-mo CTZ.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 200 bln lire of Italy 18-mo CTZ.

text.p: Specialist bond traders were allocated 200 billion lire of 18-month Italian Treasury zero coupon certificates (CTZ) on offer after bidding for 413 billion lire worth.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 5.41 trillion lire at the open auction for the December 30, 1998 paper against 2.0 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 91.55 from 91.95 and gross yield at 6.06 percent against 6.51 at the previous CTZ sale on June 11.
Specialists were also allocated 300 billion lire worth of two-year CTZs offered after bidding for 747 billion lire worth.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 5.35 trillion lire worth of the May 14, 1999 paper against an offer of 3.0 trillion lire worth. The auction price was set at 89.55 against 88.70 and gross yield at 6.08 against 6.48 percent.
